items.title: De De Pierce Interview, 1960-01-10
items.q: Remember his first name? Maybe Alba.

ctx.x: Sax. He was a good man on the sax. And who was this guy, Wright, that played tenor sax? He was a couple by Tredd, he played tenor sax or something. What was it coming in?
Remember his first name? Maybe Alba.

Maybe Alba, huh? You're not sure. I'm not sure. I'm going to it with Alba doing. I think so. I know he's becoming here. We were talking about him this morning, wasn't it? The other day, Rochon. The other day. We were talking about Rochon. Rochon, he's a preacher now, he's out of it too.
